name: e-commerce-monorepo
description: E-commerce monorepo with Next.js + Payload CMS backend and React + Tailwind frontend

scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run kill:8080 && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.kill-ports: npm run kill:3001 && npm run kill:8080
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
